title: Mapúa BS Architecture Comprehensive Exit Exam — 100-Item Grand Master Simulation
description: Full 3-Part PRC Architecture Licensure Examination (ALE) Master Blueprint Simulation covering all 7 Knowledge Clusters

questions.question: Under Table VII.1 of the 2005 Revised IRR of PD 1096 (NBCP), what is the Maximum Allowable Percentage of Site Occupancy (PSO) for an Inside Lot in a C-2 (Commercial-2) zone without a firewall?
questions.trap: Option A is for R-1 inside lots; Option B is for R-2; Option D is for C-2 corner lots with firewall abutments.

questions.question: What is the required minimum front setback for an R-1 residential zone with an RROW of 10.00 meters?
questions.trap: R-1 mandates 4.50m front setback (total 8.00m at grade when parking is provided outside the front yard).

questions.question: Under RA 9514 IRR Section 10.2.5.2, what is the statutory occupant load factor for an educational classroom?
questions.trap: 0.65 is concentrated assembly; 1.40 is unconcentrated dining; 4.60 is vocational shop/laboratory.

questions.question: What is the maximum allowable travel distance to an exit in a building equipped with an approved automatic fire sprinkler system (AFSS)?
questions.trap: 46.00 m is the limit without sprinklers; with approved sprinklers it expands to 61.00 m.

questions.question: What is the egress width capacity factor for stairways in an unsprinklered building under RA 9514?
questions.trap: 5.0 mm/p is for level components and doors; 7.6 mm/p is for stairs.

questions.question: Under BP 344 Rule II Section 2, what is the maximum allowable gradient/slope for pedestrian accessible ramps?
questions.trap: 1:8 is permitted only for very short vertical rises under 50 mm.

questions.question: What is the maximum horizontal run permitted for a single accessible ramp section before a level landing of at least 1.50 m must be provided?
questions.trap: Every 6.00 m run requires a 1.50 m intermediate landing.

questions.question: What is the minimum clear doorway opening width required for accessible doors under BP 344?
questions.trap: 0.71 m is NBCP minimum; BP 344 strictly requires 0.80 m clear opening.

questions.question: What are the standard internal dimensions for a fully compliant BP 344 accessible toilet stall?
questions.trap: 1.50m is the turning circle; 1.70m x 1.80m is the full cubicle footprint with outward-swinging door.

questions.question: What is the total minimum width required for an accessible parking slot under BP 344?
questions.trap: Comprises 2.50 m vehicle bay plus 1.20 m dedicated transfer access aisle.

questions.question: Under Section 15 of RA 9266, what is the minimum weighted general average and minimum individual subject score required to pass the Architecture Licensure Examination (ALE)?
questions.trap: 70% general average with no grade lower than 50% in any subject is statutory.

questions.question: Under Section 33 of RA 9266, who owns the intellectual property and copyright of architectural plans and specifications?

options.A: The Client who commissioned the work

questions.trap: The client owns only the physical paper copies; copyright remains with the architect.

questions.question: What is the criminal penalty under Section 44 of RA 9266 for unauthorized practice of architecture by an unlicensed individual?

options.C: Fine of P100,000 to P5,000,000, or 6 months to 6 years imprisonment (or both)

questions.trap: P100k to P5M and/or 6 months to 6 years imprisonment is the exact statutory penalty.

questions.question: In SPP 202 Regular Design Services, what cumulative percentage of the Basic Professional Fee is due to the architect upon completion and delivery of the Contract Documents Phase?
questions.trap: 15% (SD) + 20% (DD) + 40% (CD) = 75% cumulative.

questions.question: What fee percentage is allocated to the Construction Administration (Phase 5) of SPP 202 Regular Design Services?
questions.trap: Bidding is 5%; Construction Administration is 20%.

questions.question: Under SPP 207, what is the standard professional fee for Design-Build Services on a Guaranteed Maximum Cost (GMC) basis?
questions.trap: 7% is for Design-Build by Administration; 10% is for Guaranteed Maximum Cost.

questions.question: Under UAP Document 301, what is the standard contractor guarantee/defects liability period for materials and workmanship following final acceptance?
questions.trap: Contractor warranty under UAP Doc 301 is 1 year; 15 years is civil liability under Civil Code Art. 1723.

questions.question: Under Article 1723 of the Philippine Civil Code, what is the duration of civil liability for the Architect-of-Record if a building collapses due to defect in plans?
questions.trap: 15 years from completion of structure; prescriptive period to sue is 10 years from collapse.

questions.question: Under Executive Order No. 1008, what tribunal holds original and exclusive jurisdiction over construction contract disputes in the Philippines?
questions.trap: CIAC arbitral awards are final and unappealable on questions of fact.

questions.question: Under RA 9266 Section 34, what minimum percentage of ownership and voting stock in an architectural corporation must be held by Registered and Licensed Architects?
questions.trap: 75% minimum RLA voting stock ownership is mandatory.

questions.question: Under Article 51 of PD 1067 (Water Code of the Philippines), what is the mandatory riverbank easement in urban areas?
questions.trap: 3.00 m for urban; 20.00 m for agricultural; 40.00 m for forest areas.

questions.question: Under Section 15 of PD 705 (Revised Forestry Code), what is the statutory slope threshold above which lands are classified as non-alienable forest reserve?
questions.trap: Lands 18% or steeper cannot be classified as alienable or disposable.

questions.question: What is the maximum allowable dead-end corridor length in a building without an automatic sprinkler system under RA 9514?
questions.trap: 6.00 m without sprinklers; 15.00 m with approved sprinklers.

questions.question: According to the Half-Diagonal Rule under RA 9514, what is the minimum straight-line separation distance between two required exits in an unsprinklered building with overall diagonal D?
questions.trap: D / 2 for unsprinklered; reduced to D / 3 for sprinklered buildings.

questions.question: What maximum force may be required to release panic hardware on an exit door under RA 9514?
questions.trap: 66 N (15 lbf) maximum operating push force.

questions.question: Who designed the Step Pyramid of Djoser at Saqqara, historically recognized as the first named architect in recorded history?
questions.trap: Senenmut designed Hatshepsut temple; Imhotep built the first stone pyramid (c. 2670 BCE).

questions.question: What optical refinement was incorporated into the stylobate platform of the Parthenon in Athens?

options.B: Convex upward curvature (60mm on long sides)

questions.trap: Upward curvature corrects the optical illusion of center sagging.

questions.question: Which classical Greek order is characterized by a capital with spiral volute scrolls and a molded base?
questions.trap: Doric has no base; Corinthian has acanthus leaves; Ionic has volute scrolls.

questions.question: What is the interior diameter of the unreinforced concrete dome of the Roman Pantheon?
questions.trap: 43.30 m exactly equals the interior height, forming a perfect sphere.

questions.question: What structural masonry element enabled Byzantine architects to support the circular central dome of Hagia Sophia over a square bay?
questions.trap: Pendentives are spherical triangular vaults; squinches are diagonal corner arches.

questions.question: Which triad of structural innovations defines High Gothic architecture?

options.A: Semicircular arch, barrel vault, thick wall
options.B: Pointed arch, ribbed groin vault, flying buttress

questions.trap: Pointed arches reduce lateral thrust, ribbed vaults concentrate loads, flying buttresses transfer forces outward.

questions.question: Which historic basilica is universally recognized as the birthplace of Gothic architecture under Abbot Suger?
questions.trap: Abbot Suger consecrated Saint-Denis choir in 1144 pioneering Lux Nova.

questions.question: In Francis D.K. Ching's Theory of Architecture, what primary ordering principle describes a line, plane, or volume to which other elements in a composition can relate?
questions.trap: A datum organizes an irregular pattern of elements through regularity and continuity.

questions.question: What are the three fundamental qualities of architecture defined by Vitruvius in De Architectura?
questions.trap: Strength (Firmitas), Utility (Utilitas), and Beauty (Venustas).

questions.question: Which UNESCO World Heritage church in Manila is the oldest stone church in the Philippines, featuring earthquake-baroque barrel vaulting?
questions.trap: San Agustin (Juan Macias, completed 1607) survived all major Philippine earthquakes.

questions.question: A terrain rises 4.00 meters vertically across a horizontal run of 80.00 meters. What is the slope percentage?
In the Rational Method formula Q = (C * I * A) / 360, what is the unit of runoff discharge Q when rainfall intensity I is in mm/hr and area A is in hectares?
questions.trap: In metric Rational Formula with 360 denominator, Q is in cubic meters per second (m³/s).

questions.question: Who pioneered the layer-cake environmental overlay method in his 1969 book "Design with Nature", establishing the basis for modern GIS site planning?
questions.trap: Ian McHarg pioneered the ecological layer-cake method.

questions.question: What is the primary function of weep holes installed in structural concrete retaining walls?

options.B: Relieve hydrostatic water pressure behind the wall

questions.trap: Weep holes prevent hydrostatic water pressure buildup, the #1 cause of retaining wall failure.

questions.question: What is the earthwork volume by the End-Area method for a 50-meter trench with cross-sectional areas A1 = 10.0 sqm and A2 = 20.0 sqm?
What is the standard water-cement ratio by weight for Class A structural concrete (3,000 psi)?
questions.trap: 0.45-0.55 provides optimal workability and 28-day compressive strength without excessive porosity.

questions.question: What is the minimum concrete compressive strength (f'ci) required before transferring post-tensioning prestress forces per ACI 318?
questions.trap: 20.5 MPa (3,000 psi) is the statutory minimum transfer strength.

questions.question: Which of the following is an immediate (elastic) loss of prestress in post-tensioned members?
questions.trap: Friction and wedge anchorage slip occur immediately during jacking; creep/shrinkage/relaxation are time-dependent.

questions.question: Which timber wood joint is strongest for resisting longitudinal tensile pull along a spliced beam?
questions.trap: A keyed/bolted scarf joint transfers tension across the spliced timber cross-section.

questions.question: In Philippine construction practice, what is the nominal thickness of a non-load-bearing interior Concrete Hollow Block (CHB) partition?
questions.trap: 100 mm (4 in) is for interior partitions; 150 mm (6 in) is for exterior walls.

questions.question: In structural steel designations such as W 310 x 38.7, what does the number "38.7" represent?

options.C: Nominal mass in kilograms per meter (kg/m)

questions.trap: 310 is nominal depth in mm; 38.7 is weight/mass in kg/m.

questions.question: In high-rise curtain wall engineering, what design principle uses an equalized air pressure chamber to prevent wind-driven rainwater penetration?
questions.trap: The rainscreen principle neutralizes air pressure difference across the outer facade.

questions.question: Which waterproofing system is most recommended for exposed concrete roof decks subject to extreme tropical UV and thermal movement in the Philippines?
questions.trap: Torch-applied elastomeric SBS membranes accommodate concrete thermal expansion and contraction.

questions.question: What type of safety glass breaks into small, relatively harmless granular cubes rather than jagged shards upon impact?
questions.trap: Tempered glass shatters into blunt granular cubes due to surface compressive prestress.

questions.question: What type of paint base is standardly used for exterior masonry concrete walls in the Philippines due to its alkali resistance and water-thinned breathability?
questions.trap: Acrylic latex is water-based, alkali-resistant, and allows concrete moisture vapor to escape.

questions.question: When building on soft saturated soil with bedrock 25 meters deep, which foundation system transfers building loads via end-bearing and skin friction?
questions.trap: Bored piles penetrate soft strata to transfer massive column loads to deep bedrock.

questions.question: Where should a polyethylene vapor barrier be installed in a concrete slab-on-ground construction?

options.A: On top of the tile finish
options.B: Between the compacted gravel bed and the concrete slab

questions.trap: Placing vapor barrier beneath the slab prevents subsoil moisture from rising into floor finishes.

questions.question: What is the cooling capacity equivalent of 1 Ton of Refrigeration (TR) in BTU/hr and Kilowatts?
questions.trap: 1 TR = 12,000 BTU/hr = 3.517 kW of heat extraction rate.

questions.question: Using Sabine's metric formula (RT60 = 0.161 V / A), what is the reverberation time for a 1,000 m³ hall with total absorption A = 161 metric sabins?
Under the Philippine Electrical Code (PEC 2017), what is the standard nominal single-phase voltage in the Philippines?
questions.trap: 230V / 60Hz is the official standard nominal voltage in the Philippines.

questions.question: What is the minimum conductor size permitted for a standard 20-Ampere branch circuit using copper wire under PEC?
questions.trap: 3.5 mm² (#12 AWG) is mandatory for 20A; 2.0 mm² is capped at 15A.

questions.question: What is the maximum allowable voltage drop on an electrical branch circuit under the Philippine Electrical Code?
questions.trap: 3% max on branch circuits; 5% total combined feeder + branch.

questions.question: An architectural studio measuring 100 sqm requires 500 Lux. Using luminaires of 5,000 lumens with CU = 0.60 and LLF = 0.80, how many fixtures are needed?
What is the maximum statutory coverage radius for a photoelectric smoke detector on a flat smooth ceiling under NFPA 72 and RA 9514?
questions.trap: 9.00 m radius provides 80.00 sqm coverage area per smoke detector.

questions.question: Within how many seconds must an emergency standby generator start and transfer life safety power through an Automatic Transfer Switch (ATS)?
questions.trap: 10 seconds maximum start and transfer time for emergency life safety loads.

questions.question: Under the Revised National Plumbing Code of the Philippines (NPCP), what is the minimum slope required for horizontal building drainage pipes 100 mm (4 in) and smaller?
questions.trap: 2.0% (1:50) is the standard self-scouring minimum slope for 100 mm drains.

questions.question: In a 2-chamber septic tank, what percentage of the total liquid capacity must be allocated to the digestion (primary) chamber?
questions.trap: Primary digestion chamber must hold 2/3 of total capacity; secondary leaching chamber holds 1/3.

questions.question: What is the standard maximum car speed for passenger traction elevators in low-to-midrise buildings (4-10 storeys)?
questions.trap: 1.00-1.75 m/s is standard for midrise; high-rise gearless elevators exceed 2.5-6.0 m/s.

questions.question: Which acoustic metric measures the ability of a partition wall to block airborne sound transmission between adjacent rooms?
questions.trap: STC measures transmission loss through walls; NRC measures surface absorption.

questions.question: What is the maximum bending moment for a simply supported beam of span L = 6.00 m carrying a uniformly distributed load of w = 20.00 kN/m?
questions.trap: Mmax = wL²/8 = (20 x 36) / 8 = 720 / 8 = 90.00 kN·m at midspan.

questions.question: What is the maximum bending moment for a simply supported beam of span L = 8.00 m carrying a center concentrated load P = 50.00 kN?
What is the maximum bending moment in a cantilever beam of span L = 3.00 m carrying a uniform load w = 12.00 kN/m?
questions.trap: Mmax = -wL²/2 = -(12 x 9) / 2 = -54.00 kN·m at fixed support.

questions.question: What is the Section Modulus (S) of a rectangular beam with width b = 200 mm and depth h = 400 mm?
A beam with S = 2.0 x 10⁶ mm³ resists a maximum bending moment M = 80.00 kN·m. What is the maximum bending stress?
In a planar truss, if two non-collinear members meet at an unloaded joint with no support reactions, what are the member forces?
questions.trap: By static equilibrium at the 2-member unloaded joint, both members carry zero force.

questions.question: What is the Fixed-End Moment (FEM) at the supports of a fixed-ended beam of span L = 6.00 m with uniform load w = 18.00 kN/m?
In the Moment Distribution Method, what is the modified stiffness K' of a beam member whose far end is pinned/roller?
questions.trap: Pinned far end stiffness is 3EI/L = 3/4 of fixed stiffness 4EI/L.

questions.question: What is the Distribution Factor (DF) for an interior joint connecting member BA (K=3) and member BC (K=5)?
Under NSCP 2015, what is the strength reduction factor (phi) for tension-controlled flexural reinforced concrete members?
questions.trap: 0.90 is the flexural reduction factor for ductile tension-controlled beams; 0.65 is for tied columns.

questions.question: What is the primary ultimate gravity load combination factor under NSCP 2015 / ACI 318?
questions.trap: 1.2D + 1.6L is standard in NSCP 2015; 1.4D + 1.7L was older ACI 318-99 code.

questions.question: In space programming for hospital and medical facilities, what standard circulation multiplier (Cm) is typically added to Net Floor Area?
questions.trap: Hospitals require +35% to +45% due to 2.44m stretcher corridors, airlocks, and sterile chases.

questions.question: In Philippine tropical architecture, why is orienting a building with its long axis along the East-West line recommended?

options.B: To face the primary road right-of-way
options.C: To minimize direct solar heat gain on large wall expanses while maximizing North-South daylighting

questions.trap: East-West axis orientation keeps major glazed facades facing North and South for glare-free light.

questions.question: Why are service cores (restrooms, stairwells, elevator banks) ideally situated on the Western façade of tropical buildings?

options.B: To act as a thermal buffer zone absorbing harsh afternoon solar heat gain

questions.trap: Placing non-habitable buffer rooms on the west shields interior workspaces from 13:00-16:00 heat.

questions.question: In an adjacency matrix, what is the required relationship between a sterile surgical suite and a general public visitor lobby?
questions.trap: Public circulation must never cross sterile hospital corridors to prevent contamination.

questions.question: Which service core typology provides the most symmetrical torsional stiffness for high-rise seismic resistance?
questions.trap: A central shear core provides balanced stiffness and short walking distances to all perimeters.

questions.question: What is the primary spatial efficiency advantage of a double-loaded corridor over a single-loaded corridor?

options.B: One central circulation spine serves functional rooms on both sides, minimizing circulation area percentage

questions.trap: Double-loaded corridors maximize usable area per meter of corridor length.

questions.question: A project brief lists 600 sqm of net functional office rooms. Applying a +25% circulation factor, what is the resulting Gross Floor Area (GFA)?
What is the minimum clear corridor width for patient-occupied hospital wings under RA 9514 and BP 344?
questions.trap: 2.44 m (8 ft) allows two hospital gurneys to pass during emergency evacuation.

questions.question: Which diagrammatic drawing translates tabular adjacency matrices into proportional spatial clusters and circulation flow vectors?
questions.trap: Bubble diagrams represent functional topological connections before drafting rigid walls.

questions.question: In a multi-level commercial building, where should heavy public traffic functions like pharmacy and emergency triage be located?

options.C: Ground floor with direct exterior street access

questions.trap: High-volume public and emergency services must occupy the ground floor for immediate access.

questions.question: A commercial lot measures 20.00 m wide by 30.00 m deep (TLA = 600 sqm) in a C-2 zone with PSO = 75%. What is the Allowable Maximum Building Footprint (AMBF)?
questions.trap: AMBF = TLA x PSO = 600 x 0.75 = 450.00 sqm.

questions.category: Integrated Scenario: Fire Code Egress Width
questions.question: A 4-storey commercial building has an occupant load of 600 persons on the 3rd floor in an unsprinklered building. What is the total required stair egress width?
questions.trap: W = 600 persons x 7.6 mm/person = 4,560 mm = 4.56 m.

questions.question: A building entrance is elevated 1.50 m above sidewalk grade. At the maximum statutory slope of 1:12, what is the minimum total sloped ramp run length required?
questions.trap: Run L = Height x 12 = 1.50 x 12 = 18.00 m (divided into three 6.00m runs with intermediate landings).

questions.question: A commercial shopping center has 250 standard parking slots. How many accessible parking slots are required under BP 344?
questions.trap: First 100 slots require 4 accessible slots; remaining 150 require ceil(150/50) = 3 -> Total = 4 + 3 = 7 slots.

questions.question: A project has an agreed Basic Professional Fee (BPF) of P5,000,000. How much cumulative fee is payable upon completion of the Schematic Design Phase (Phase 1)?
questions.trap: Phase 1 Schematic Design fee is 15% = P5,000,000 x 0.15 = P750,000.

questions.question: A simply supported beam of span L = 6.00 m carries a point load P = 40 kN at 2.00 m from left support A. What is the reaction at support A?
A 230V single-phase air conditioning unit has a rated load of 3,450 Watts with PF = 1.0. What is the operating current?
What happens to the reverberation time (RT60) of a lecture hall if total room absorption (A) is doubled while room volume remains unchanged?
questions.trap: Sabine formula RT60 = 0.161 V / A is inversely proportional to absorption.

questions.category: Integrated Scenario: Fire Code Door Swing
questions.question: Under RA 9514, what occupant load threshold mandates that room exit doors MUST swing in the direction of exit travel (outward)?
questions.trap: Any room serving 50 or more occupants must have outward-swinging doors.

questions.question: What is the nominal ultimate tensile strength (fpu) of standard 7-wire low-relaxation prestressing steel strand (Grade 270)?
questions.trap: Grade 270 prestressing strand has an ultimate tensile strength of 1,860 MPa (270,000 psi).

questions.question: In a 2-span continuous beam under uniform load w = 24 kN/m with span lengths L = 5.00 m, what is the approximate ACI negative design moment over the interior support?
If a lighting fixture is mounted at a height twice as far from the workplane (distance 2d vs d), how is the illuminance on the surface affected per the Inverse Square Law?
questions.trap: Illuminance follows the inverse square law E = I / d²; doubling distance reduces light to 1/4.

questions.question: Under the PRBoA Code of Ethical Conduct, when is an architect permitted to quote professional fees for a project already being designed by another architect?

options.B: If the fee quoted is 20% lower
options.C: Only after the prior architect's contract is officially terminated in writing and the prior architect is formally notified

questions.trap: An architect cannot intervene until the prior architect's commission is legally terminated in writing.

questions.question: A 1.0-hectare completely paved concrete roof deck (C = 0.90) experiences a storm of intensity I = 100 mm/hr. What is the peak runoff discharge Q?
Which of the following architectural design decisions violates BOTH RA 9514 (Fire Code) and BP 344 (Accessibility Law)?

options.A: Installing dual handrails on a 1:12 ramp
options.B: A main public classroom door with a 0.70 m clear opening swinging inward into the room
options.C: Providing an outward swinging door in a 1.70 x 1.80 m toilet stall
options.D: Placing accessible parking 25 meters from the entrance

questions.trap: 0.70m violates BP 344 (min 0.80m); inward swing for classrooms serving >=50 violates RA 9514!
